items.prompt: Listen and choose the word.
items.storyText: There is some mud. The mud is sad. A pup digs in the mud. A bug puts a pit in the mud. The sun comes up. It is a bud! Now the mud is happy.
items.why: In “The Mud”, you hear: The sun comes up. The missing word is “sun”.
items.hint: Listen to this sentence again. Look at the story picture.
